title: Sexto ao Decimo
label: ch:pt-ordinais-ate-decimo
canDo: I can count in order all the way to tenth, say why oitavo and nono break the pattern in different ways, and read an ordinal written as a digit with a raised letter.

payoff.summary: The written ordinal -- digit plus a raised letter that agrees in gender -- put against the ten spoken words the two chapters taught.
